entities.name: PMID:25087846
observations: Prospective comparative study of 65 patients with short-segment Barrett oesophagus monitored by impedance-pH during PPI therapy; 15 developed incident dysplasia at 3-year surveillance and 50 did not.

entities.name: Short-segment Barrett oesophagus
observations: In a 2014 cohort, incident dysplasia was associated with impaired chemical clearance but not significantly different gastric or oesophageal acid exposure during PPI therapy.

entities.name: Impaired chemical clearance
observations: The PSPW index was lower in patients developing incident dysplasia than in those without dysplasia: 15% versus 32% at surveillance and 12% versus 30% at index endoscopy; P=0.001. PSPW index below 26% predicted dysplasia with 75% accuracy.

entities.name: PPI acid suppression
observations: All patients reported heartburn suppression; 58/65 received standard PPI doses. Gastric and oesophageal acid exposure did not differ significantly between dysplasia and nondysplasia groups at surveillance or index endoscopy (P>0.05).
